certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: Office 365, Office 365 U.S. Government, Office 365 U.S. Government - High, Office 365 U.S. Government Defense [are explicitly listed as in-scope for the SOC 2 Type 2 attestation report]. Microsoft commissions a full SOC 1 Type 2 and SOC 2 Type 2 examination of Office 365 annually.

certifications.name: SOC 1 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: Microsoft commissions a full SOC 1 Type 2 and SOC 2 Type 2 examination of Office 365 annually.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
certifications.proof_quote: Auditors review Office 365 cloud services at least annually against the ISO 27001:2013 standard. [Certificate reference:] Microsoft 365 - ISO 27001:2022 Certificate (2024-2027)

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27018
certifications.proof_quote: Your control over your data is reinforced by Microsoft's commitment to comply with broadly applicable privacy laws, such as the GDPR, and privacy standards, such as ISO/IEC 27018, the world's first international code of practice for cloud privacy.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Microsoft 365 Copilot provides broad compliance offerings and certifications, including GDPR, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and the ISO 42001 standard for AI management systems.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Management Systems)
certifications.proof_quote: Microsoft 365 Copilot provides broad compliance offerings and certifications, including GDPR, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and the ISO 42001 standard for AI management systems.

certifications.name: FERPA
certifications.proof_quote: In the Online Services Terms Data Protection Addendum (DPA), Microsoft agrees to be designated as a 'school official' with 'legitimate educational interests' in customer data as defined under FERPA. When Microsoft handles student education records, Microsoft agrees to abide by the limitations and requirements imposed by 34 CFR 99.33(a) just as school officials do.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Microsoft 365 Copilot, including Microsoft 365 Copilot Search, is compliant with our existing privacy, security, and compliance commitments to Microsoft 365 commercial customers, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and European Union (EU) Data Boundary.

certifications.name: EU AI Act
certifications.proof_quote: Microsoft is committed to complying with all laws and regulations applicable to Microsoft, including the EU AI Act, to enable our AI solutions to meet evolving standards for trustworthy and responsible AI.

privacy.ai_training_note: Prompts, responses, and data accessed through Microsoft Graph are not used to train foundation LLMs, including those used by Microsoft 365 Copilot. Optional user feedback is also not used to train foundation LLMs. Interaction data is encrypted at rest and stored within the Microsoft 365 service boundary. DPA available at https://aka.ms/DPA covers customer data including student records under FERPA school official designation.
privacy.data_region: EU Data Boundary for EU customers (LLM processing stays within EU); Advanced Data Residency (ADR) and Multi-Geo options available for enterprise customers; Copilot added as covered workload in data residency commitments as of March 1, 2024; customers outside the EU may have queries processed in US, EU, or other regions unless ADR is purchased.

security.name: Bug Bounty Program
security.value: Microsoft-operated MSRC in-house program (not HackerOne or Bugcrowd). Dedicated Microsoft Copilot Bounty Program pays $250-$30,000 USD per qualifying submission. Scope includes Copilot on web, Edge, mobile, Windows, and integrated experiences.

security.name: Third-Party Audits
security.value: Annual ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type 2 examinations by independent AICPA-accredited CPA firms. Mid-year SOC Type 1 audits also conducted for new services. Quarterly bridge letters issued.

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: BitLocker and per-file encryption for all stored data including Copilot interaction history.

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: Transport Layer Security (TLS) and Internet Protocol Security (IPsec) for all data in transit.

security.name: Content Safety Filters
security.value: Hate/Fairness, Sexual, Violence, and Self-harm filters active on prompts and responses; jailbreak and cross-prompt injection attack (XPIA) classifiers; protected material detection for text and code.

security.name: Zero Trust and Tenant Isolation
security.value: Logical isolation of customer content within each tenant via Microsoft Entra authorization and role-based access control. Copilot only surfaces data the individual user is authorized to access.

security.name: LLM Processing
security.value: Azure OpenAI Services used for processing (not public OpenAI). Azure OpenAI does not cache customer content or Copilot-modified prompts. Abuse monitoring with human review has been opted out of for M365 Copilot services.

security.name: Audit Reports Access
security.value: SOC and ISO audit reports available via Microsoft Service Trust Portal (servicetrust.microsoft.com) to verified subscribers.

products.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot (Licensed Add-on)
products.data_scope: Full Microsoft Graph access within tenant boundary; prompts and responses stored in M365 and governed by DPA and FERPA school official designation; no data used to train LLMs; EU Data Boundary and ADR apply.
products.notes: Requires Microsoft 365 E3/E5 or equivalent Education license plus Copilot add-on. Full SOC2, ISO27001, HIPAA, GDPR, and FERPA coverage. Admins can control agent access, retention policies, and data deletion.

products.name: Copilot Chat / Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat (Free Tier)
products.category: AI Chat Interface for Students and Educators
products.data_scope: Enterprise data protection applies when signed into school or work account; web search queries are explicitly NOT covered by DPA or FERPA; prompts and responses stored under Microsoft privacy statement when no DPA is in effect.
products.notes: Available free to students 13+ and educators via Microsoft 365 Education. FERPA compliance is limited: chat content is protected but web search queries fall outside FERPA scope. Admins should review configuration before student use involving sensitive records.

products.name: Microsoft Learn Educator Center
products.data_scope: Training completion data and certifications earned; governed by Microsoft Privacy Statement; no student record processing.
products.notes: Non-AI training platform at education.microsoft.com. Free for all educators. Not an AI product generating content; outside FERPA scope.

products.name: AI Education Tools (Reading Coach, Reading Progress, Immersive Reader)
products.data_scope: Student reading fluency data processed within school M365 tenant; governed by FERPA school official designation in DPA; data does not leave tenant for LLM training.
products.notes: Free tools included in Microsoft 365 Education licenses. Covered under same SOC2 and ISO27001 scope as Office 365 Commercial. Recommended for K-12 use with FERPA-covered student populations.

compare.pricing_model: Tiered: free AI education tools and Copilot Chat via Microsoft 365 Education; licensed Microsoft 365 Copilot add-on for full generative AI features (approx. $30/user/month on top of M365 Education license); enterprise volume licensing via Microsoft EA
compare.data_residency: EU Data Boundary included for EU tenants at no extra cost; Advanced Data Residency (ADR) and Multi-Geo available as paid add-ons for regional data control outside EU; Copilot is a covered workload since March 1, 2024

flags: FERPA coverage has an important gap: web search queries generated by Copilot Chat are explicitly NOT covered by the Data Protection Addendum and therefore fall outside FERPA protections; institutions must disable web search for FERPA-sensitive workflows.

Anthropic models are used as a subprocessor for some M365 Copilot experiences and are explicitly out of scope for the EU Data Boundary and in-country LLM processing commitments per Microsoft's own documentation.
Bug bounty is operated through Microsoft's own MSRC portal, not a third-party platform such as HackerOne or Bugcrowd.

Microsoft 365 Copilot (paid add-on) and free Copilot Chat have different compliance scopes; the free tier lacks the same DPA protections and FERPA designation unless configured under a school enterprise agreement.
